image_description: A close-up shot of three figs on a white surface. One whole fig sits in the center, displaying purple and green striped skin with a small stem. Two halves of a fig flank it, revealing a deep red/pink interior filled with numerous tiny seeds and fleshy pulp.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pear-shaped fruit with soft, thin skin in green, purple, or brownish coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central fruit exhibits the characteristic pear shape and the skin shows distinct purple and green coloration consistent with ripe fig varieties.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth to slightly wrinkled texture with matte finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin appears smooth with a natural matte sheen, lacking the artificial gloss often seen in AI generations.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated pear shape with tapered form from broad base to narrow stem end.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The geometry of the whole fig correctly tapers from the wide bottom to the narrower top where the stem attaches.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small ostiole (eye) at bottom of fruit.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bottom of the central fig is obscured by the cut half in the foreground; the ostiole is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Narrow stem end contrasting with broad rounded base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The stem attachment point is visible and correctly proportioned relative to the broader base of the fruit.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin, easily bruised skin covering soft interior.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The cut edges show a very thin skin layer separating the exterior from the internal pulp, consistent with biological reality.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cut cross-section reveals hollow interior filled with numerous tiny seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The halved figs clearly display a complex internal structure packed with many small, distinct seeds.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Sweet, pink to amber-colored fleshy pulp surrounding seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The interior flesh is a vibrant deep pink/red color, matching the description of ripe fig pulp.
The visual texture of the cut surface appears moist and soft, consistent with a jam-like consistency rather than a dry or solid core.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific botanical identity of the fruit and rule out look-alikes or hallucinated hybrid fruits.
To verify that the seeds are distinct entities embedded in pulp and not melting into each other or the background.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the skin or pulp that might indicate generative artifacts.
To ensure the overlapping figs have correct spatial relationships and contact shadows.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the skin and the inner flesh. In AI images, this boundary often blurs or melts. Also, verify that the seeds in the cross-section are individually distinct and not just a noisy texture pattern.
